item.title: Construction launches for Palo Alto’s newest teacher housing project
item.description: Palo Alto’s newest teacher housing project, The Academy, is finally ready for construction. Community partners ceremoniously dug shovels into dirt on the 3265 El Camino Real construction site on Thursday afternoon to initiate the official start of developer Half Dome Capital’s apartment complex in the Ventura neighborhood.
